title: Rating a Reference accepts it, and stars fill to the left
description: Ryan, 2026-11-05, Machines on Machines: 'If I rate the number of stars then it should become approved automatically.' Four videos got stars and stayed pending; the data shows no race, an accept that never registered or the assumption that rating accepts. Any star rating on a pending Reference also records it accepted by the same person. Also: pressing a star fills it and every star to its left; today only the pressed one lights. Newsroom cards, the Add dialog and anywhere stars are set. Gherkin.
